name: 33193 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33193 (Miami) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33193 (Miami) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
78% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33193 (Miami) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 19% of the typical level).
